response.content: {"visual":{"fullPrompt":"Locked hero product frame, modern social-first beauty photography, shot slightly above eye level with direct on-camera flash: SCARLETT VEGA, in a fitted black cotton turtleneck with sleeves pushed to the elbows, small gold hoop earrings and a thin silver ring on her right index finger, leans into frame from camera right, both hands cradling the upright lipstick tube from (CORAL_LIPSTICK) at the center of a bone-white kitchen counter, her fingers mid-twist on the ribbed base as the bullet rises, wrist rotating so she tilts the tube toward the lens like a piece of evidence, shoulders squared, breath held, deadpan raised-eyebrow look flicking straight into the camera. Around her the walk-up apartment kitchen counter is spare and curated: a folded paper napkin, two subway tokens, a cracked flip phone face-down, the edge of an oat-beige carton pushed just out of focus, crumbs catching light on the matte counter surface. Behind her, warm cream tile and a sliver of late-afternoon window blowing out to soft white, the flash flattening the foreground into crisp punchy contrast while the background falls a stop darker with a faint hard shadow ringing the tube's base. Glare skates across the polished gold seam and the wet-looking gloss of the flat-cut bullet, tiny specular highlight blooming on the pigment. High-key airy grade, crisp whites, warm natural skin, lifted shadows, single saturated coral accent against neutral bone and oat-beige. Shot on a 50mm prime at f/4, slight top-down tilt, shallow falloff at the frame edges, fine editorial digital grain, 16:9.","negativePrompt":"holographic screens, holograms, floating UI, HUD, text overlays, subtitles, captions, watermarks, invented logos or typography, redesigned lipstick packaging, heavy diffusion, moody low-key lighting, teal-orange grade, motion blur, cluttered background, extra hands, deformed fingers, multiple lipsticks, plastic skin, oversaturated colors, mirrors, duplicate characters"}}
